name: Notion
prompt: Build a local-first team wiki with Markdown pages, nested navigation, full-text search, tags, backlinks, and SQLite persistence. Include a fast command palette, slash commands, keyboard shortcuts, export to Markdown, and a restrained responsive interface. Add optimistic autosave and a simple share-by-link mode.
notes: A focused wiki is very buildable. Notion's collaboration edge cases and ecosystem are the hard part.
